встречаться.gloss: to meet; to date, go out

meanings.en: to date, go out with each other
meanings.note: Мы встречаемся = we're dating. Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'тречаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to meet; to date, go out', paired with 'встретиться'.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must, should; owe').

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

examples.text: Ну что ты молчишь? Ты толстый, ты не спортсмен!
examples.trans: Well, why are you so quiet? You're fat, you're no athlete!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: + dative of the person. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ветить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to answer, to reply', paired with 'отвечать'.
Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ветить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to answer, to reply', paired with 'отвечать'.

examples.text: Прости, я должен ответить. Да, Аллочка!
examples.trans: Sorry, I have to answer this. Yes, Allochka!

meanings.en: to answer, to reply, to pick up the phone
meanings.note: Отвечать кому / на звонок. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'вечать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to answer, to reply', paired with 'ответить'.

examples.text: Я вам звоню, а вы не отвечаете!
examples.trans: I call you, and you don't answer!

examples.text: Почему ты не отвечаешь на мои вопросы?

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понимать'.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: Asks about the reason. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'чему').

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: Кого о чём. Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (stem 'упредить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to warn, notify in advance', paired with 'предупреждать'.

examples.trans: And they warned me very strictly!

meanings.note: State prosecution service. Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'куратура'). Common feminine noun meaning 'prosecutor's office' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Here is an order from the prosecutor's office.

examples.text: Вот бумага из прокуратуры. Слушание будет сегодня вечером.
examples.trans: Here is an order from the prosecutor's office. The hearing will be this evening.

meanings.note: Spoken exchange. Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'говор'). Common masculine noun meaning 'conversation, talk' in everyday Russian.
